subject.title: fix(commands): re-check owner for cross-channel /allowlist writes

question: Should channel-, account-, and context-derived owners be limited to their exact origin scope for `/allowlist` mutations, while configured commands.ownerAllowFrom owners, its wildcard, and gateway operator.admin retain cross-scope authority?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but this is a permanent privilege and upgrade contract that cannot be inferred safely from tests or contributor intent alone.

options.title: Approve exact-scope ownership
options.body: Require target ownership whenever channel or account changes, while preserving configured global and gateway-admin authority.

options.title: Require named global owners
options.body: Permit cross-scope writes only for named commands.ownerAllowFrom identities or gateway admin, excluding wildcard owner configuration.

options.title: Preserve broader channel ownership
options.body: Allow channel-derived owners to administer other accounts under that channel, with explicit security documentation and regression tests.

recommendation.title: Approve exact-scope ownership
recommendation.body: Require target ownership whenever channel or account changes, while preserving configured global and gateway-admin authority.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the deepest merged history across command authorization, allowlist handling, and config-write policy.
